english.note: Use this when emphasizing relief that a bad outcome was avoided or a helpful circumstance came to the rescue.
Use this when emphasizing that a bad outcome was avoided or that a favorable fact came to the rescue.

examples.english: Luckily, the bus hadn't left yet, so we made it in time.
examples.traditional: 好在架巴士未開，我哋趕得切。
examples.jyutping: hou2 zoi6 gaa3 baa1 si2 mei6 hoi1 ngo5 dei6 gon2 dak1 cit3

examples.english: Fortunately, you brought an umbrella; otherwise we'd be soaked.
examples.traditional: 好在你帶咗遮，唔係我哋就濕晒。
examples.jyutping: hou2 zoi6 nei5 daai3 zo2 ze1 m4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 zau6 sap1 saai3
